	<ResortReportHeadline>Snow Incoming!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>We have some weather approaching... snow is on the way!&nbsp; The wind has picked up to a strong northwesterly and the odd fine flake is in the air.&nbsp; The current temperature is minus 3.4 which is forecast to rise to a top of zero during the day.&nbsp; Light borderline snow showers are predicted for the day before increasing overnight while the temperature drops.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>The snow has had a good solid freeze overnight and the snowguns are in action this morning.&nbsp; It'll be pretty firm out there first thing but a little fresh snow or damp precipitation may soften the surface a little as the day progresses.&nbsp; The strong wind may impact the upper lifts, so check the <a href="https://www.mthotham.com.au/mountain/conditions/lifts-terrain" rel="nofollow">lift status</a> before heading to your preferred option.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Heavenly Valley area is not perfect but there will be plenty of fun turns to be had for advanced and expert skiers and riders.&nbsp; Just take notice of the signage, as some zones runs are upgraded, or may be closed if it's too slick.&nbsp; &nbsp;The Extreme Area remains closed due to a significant sliding hazard.&nbsp; Do Not Enter, and please don't attempt to retrieve dropped equipment from any closed areas.</p><p>Rug up for the windchill this morning, and stay tuned for a whiter mountain report from Burner tomorrow morning.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Cheers BIll.&nbsp;</p></ResortReport>
